## Interpretation

Clean finite-size scaling; susceptibility peaks drift toward the Binder crossing region.

Working critical-kappa diagnostics:

- Linear Binder crossing band: `0.341952-0.343278` from 3 pair/center entries.
- Mean linear Binder crossing: `0.342570`.
- Linear extrapolation of susceptibility peak locations versus `1/L`: `0.342636` with RMS residual `0.000003`.
- Susceptibility peak-height fit: `chi_abs,max ~ L^p`, `p = 1.753487`.
